area: Waystation (GameModes 58): the Drop Tower course, WaystationTower.Lay, the hop autopilot; TIGER_MOTH.md doc numbers
summary: Lantern Towers: from I2 a share of down-hops is laid TIGHT (a shorter runway, so a shallower shelf), lantern posts mark each hop's shelf, a plunge's landing stretch is now an obstacle for later towers, an I4 crown Time crystal on every plunge; the hop AI aims at the lanterns' deep band per seat at live speed and turns round after an overshoot; a dust-stolen wall tile is no longer overlaid. Clusters and exit gates untouched. TIGER_MOTH.md: aiFoldMinDistance 420 -> 700 noted, and the wormhole rule measured (press-to-landed >= 900, i.e. from a ~779 u fall) - the code is unchanged, which rule is meant is your call. Measured: reading the lanterns saves 3.4/3.8/3.2% of tower time at I2-I4 vs the best fixed depth (WAYSTATION.md 'Lantern Towers').
